title: Great storage and attractive too!
text: Great storage and attractive too!. These are beautiful storage containers. I have them on my kitchen counter and I keep spaghetti, rigatoni, coffee and sugar in them. Such a convenient and attractive way to keep foods handy, fresh and always at your disposal. These also come in a nice box to they would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift to someone. You could also use these and fill with colorful pebbles or candies to add color to any decor, so I have already ordered another set to sit out on a shelf in my living room. I highly recommend these.
